title: Evidence narrative
intro: This report describes recorded observations. Each fact links to journal records; the report does not establish the truth of messages.
heading.limits: What this package does not establish
heading.verify: How to check the original package
scene.records: Between {from} and {to}, the journal contains {n, plural, one{# record} few{# records} many{# records} other{# records}} in this scene.
collection.counts: The recorded event counts are: new messages {messages}, edits {edits}, deletion notices {deletions}, and messages absent on recheck {missing}.
limit.clock: Limitation: observation dates come from the recording computer; an independent time check is separate.
limit.recorded: Limitation: these statements describe the journal's claims; the author of this report did not witness the underlying events.
limit.coverage: Limitation: event counts do not establish uninterrupted observation or that Telegram supplied every message.
limit.omitted: Limitation: an oversized payload value was omitted from the prose; consult the referenced original record.
limit.document: Limitation: document properties and signature checks shown here are recorded claims; this renderer does not validate a qualified signature or DKIM.
limit.gap: Limitation: the journal records an interruption; this does not establish its cause or what happened during it.
limit.unknown: Limitation: this event type has no dedicated narrative interpretation; its original record remains the source.
limit.truth: Limitation: message truth, the operator's identity, complete Telegram disclosure and external corroboration of private chats are not established.
limit.review: Machine-assisted translation; not reviewed by a lawyer or a native-language legal reviewer.
jurisdiction.notice: Terminology and source references only. This section does not assess admissibility, deadlines or legal rights and is not legal advice.
